policy.completion_rule: Acceptance criteria, production wiring, regression tests and any required real-device evidence must be met; code existence alone is not completion.
policy.source_rule: The imported static audit is historical. Keep its supplied claims intact and record new code evidence separately.

01-01.scope: 128 independent mixer tracks implemented across model, native runtime/export, routing, editor controls, browser preservation/playback and regression coverage.
01-01.remaining: Independent multi-instrument instances (01-02) are not implemented. Cross-platform and physical 128-track performance acceptance remains pending; do not interpret track count as a low-latency qualification.

03-04.scope: Native persistent named/color timeline markers, cues and regions, navigation, snapped editing, undo/redo, save/reopen, JSON/CSV metadata export and production commands/UI.
03-04.remaining: Implemented and software-tested on Linux/offscreen, not yet included in a qualified four-platform release. Browser preserves metadata but has no marker editor. Exports are beat-based metadata, not CD cue sheets or audio renders.

12-03.scope: Streaming offline stereo correlation, mid/side energy and channel statistics with a cancelable analysis UI.
12-03.remaining: Live spectrum and stereo-field scopes, calibrated display averaging and live analysis remain outstanding.

12-09.scope: Streaming file-quality report, source-safe atomic JSON/text export, usable background analysis UI and production self-check integration.
12-09.remaining: Loudness/LUFS/LRA and reconstructed true-peak measurements are not implemented; report and UI disclose this. No delivery-standard conformance claim.

19-01.owner_instruction: No paid package signing; distribute unsigned packages and advise users how to install.
19-01.replacement_acceptance: Build and validate all four native targets from one audited commit, disclose unsigned status, bundle platform installation instructions and checksums, and complete real installation/device acceptance before promotion.
19-01.remaining: Unsigned policy is implemented, but this does not waive platform, device, performance or source qualification.

19-04.scope: Existing full source and browser suites pass on the repair baseline; each new capability needs updated reference and cross-platform acceptance.

19-06.scope: Repair baseline supplies a standalone browser feature set with documented native-only limitations. Dynamic tracks now pass 73 browser UI checks and 30 actual-audio tests, including track 128 output and project reload.
19-06.remaining: Browser/native DSP and full feature parity are not complete; unsupported active native processing remains explicitly rejected rather than silently approximated.
